title: A drop of water, zoomed in a million times
why: Find the big red oxygen ball and the two small hydrogen balls; water is always these three joined in a bent shape.
credit: “Water molecule (молекула воды)” by decay_dance, CC BY 4.0, via Sketchfab

title: Inside a snowflake: the shape of ice
why: Look for the open six-sided holes; water molecules lock into this neat frame when water freezes.
credit: “Structure of ice” by Justus Mutanen, CC BY 4.0, via Sketchfab
